QuestInfo.name: That's Just My Two Pills
QuestInfo.0: It seems like the master has something to tell you. Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
The master handed you a Vitality Pill and a Mind Pill. #bUse 1 Vitality Pill and 1 Clear Mind Pill#k so he won't worry about you.


#b* You can open your inventory by pressing the I key.#k
#b* You can drag and drop the item icon to assign it to a key on the bottom right.
#k
QuestInfo.2:
You #brecovered your HP and MP#k after taking the master's Vitality Pill and Mind Pill. 


#b* You can also buy recovery potions from the town's General Store.#k

default.0: Go on, take them. You can open your inventory by pressing the I key.
